criteria.notes: Municipal kiosk: searchable document directory bound to a TABLE, with the PDF opening in place beside it.
Keeps the reference kiosk structure - masthead, category rail, directory list, reader - without copying its styling.
Deep navy institutional palette with a civic masthead; distinct from the warm paper of the donor wall and the dark dashboards.
Kiosk viewing distance: document titles and category buttons carry at arm length, and accessible reach mode enlarges both.
Default and custom branding both verified, including an independently themed screensaver overlay.
Long-labels and maximum-content scenarios show titles wrapping without clipping at every surface.
Verified 600x600 through 1920x1080 plus portrait and 1536x432; the reader and directory reflow rather than shrink.
Icons are inline SVG following currentColor; the only raster assets are the operator-supplied logo and screensaver image.
Only example teaching accessible reach mode - a viewer-toggled layout that brings controls within seated reach.
